title: Plastic hot water kettle
text: Plastic hot water kettle. Ok, I was going cheap and you totally get what you pay for most of the time.  In this case, yup - it's pretty much junk.  98% plastic and probably will work for a few months - but I only need 3 wks.  Fingers crossed.  Then, purchase something that will last - mostly glass. Costs more, but so much better for you and the world. I give it 4 stars because it works and is dollar value, but little else.  Having said all that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Ovente Electric Kettle, 1.8 Liter with Prontofill Lid 1500 Watt BPA-Free Fast Heating Element with Auto Shut-Off & Boil Dry Protection, Instant Hot Water Boiler for Coffee & Tea, Green KP413G
features: Prontofill Lid: This 1.8L electric kettle features Ovente’s patented ProntoFill lid. First of its kind in the market, this easy-fill solution is a pioneer in electric kettle technology; you fill it up without opening the lid!

Safety Features: Equipped with an auto shut-off feature that automatically shuts off the kettle once heating is completed and boil-dry protection technology, which prevents it from heating up should someone inadvertently switch it on when empty.

Indicator Light: Lets you know when your kettle is heating. Press the switch at the base of the kettle, and it illuminates red. Once boiled, the switch lifts up and the red light shuts off. For your convenience, the base has built-in cord storage slots.
Removable Spout Filter: To ensure that you get debris-free water every time, the spout has a removable filter that is easy to remove and clean. Simply slide it out and then slide it back in.
Prontofill is the original easy fill electric kettle with patent pending technology. You can choose from many versions and colors to match your needs.

US-based Customer Service lets you buy with confidence. Ovente warranties that the product shall be free from defects in material and workmanship under normal use and conditions, for 2 years from the original purchase date.
